title: Two-Phase Withdrawal Balance Caching May Orphan Yield
description: In the two-phase withdrawal system, the balance is cached at initiation (Phase 1), but the actual value may differ at execution (Phase 2, 24 hours later). Yield accrued during the waiting period becomes orphaned.
impact: Yield accrued during the 24-hour waiting period becomes orphaned and is not attributed to the withdrawing user. If the balance decreases during the waiting period, execution may also encounter issues.
attackPath: User executes withdrawal (Phase 2) with cached amount
Yield earned during waiting period is orphaned
Alternatively, if balance decreased, execution may fail or be inaccurate
codeSnippet: // Balance cached at initiation, actual value at execution may differ
recommendation: Re-read balance at execution time, or use the cached balance as a minimum/maximum with appropriate handling for differences.
